name: create_dimensions
description: Create one linear dimension in the active view across two or more elements, given their ids in order. References are picked automatically: the planar face whose normal best aligns with the dimension direction, falling back to the element itself. The dimension line runs through the element locations, offset perpendicular by offset_mm (millimetres). Simplified port of mcp-servers-for-revit create_dimensions (point-picking mode dropped; pass element ids).

params.name: element_ids
params.description: Two or more element ids (integers) to dimension between, in the order they should be chained.

params.name: offset_mm
params.description: Perpendicular offset of the dimension line from the line through the elements, in millimetres.

params.name: dimension_type_id
params.description: ElementId of a DimensionType to apply. Omit (or 0) to use the default linear dimension type.
